correctness.rationale: Dualizing the nine published Table-9 coordinates yields exactly coordinate hyperplanes and signed pairwise diagonals x=0,y=0,z=0,x±y=0,x±z=0,y±z=0, i.e. the projective B3 arrangement. Independent rational cross-product incidence enumeration confirms t2=6,t3=4,t4=3 and sum choose(m,2)=36, agreeing with nine choose two. Three multiplicity-four vertices force projective stabilizers to be monomial; diagonal factors must have ratios ±1, so |Stab|=6*4=24, isomorphic S4. The source already describes Aut(K)=S4 and nine nonidentity involutions; a faithful action on these nine points transfers the 3+6 line orbits to the 3+6 conjugacy classes. The pinned verifier independently checks all signed permutations. No issue found in these formal deductions.
